name: colleague_s_anecdote_is_not_policy
use_case: Report missing evidence and open a knowledge request with consent
branch: Grace Kim (E05) asks if she can expense dog boarding because Sam said in Slack he expensed his; desk checks Slack thread and policies, notes colleague experience is not policy, and offers a request
tests: the agent reads the Slack thread and searches policies, states pet boarding is not covered and anecdotes are not policy, and offers a knowledge request
instruction:
You saw a comment in Slack thread 1793962800.000017 from Sam Taylor saying he successfully expensed dog boarding. You ask the Knowledge Desk if company policy officially covers pet boarding. If the desk clarifies that no policy covers pet boarding and a colleague's anecdote is not policy, decline when offered a knowledge request.
